messages:
sam: hey everyone :wave: I'm opening my first PR for the runtime repo, quick q on smoke tests and branch naming. I used feature/ONB-312-first-pr but CI failed with `ci/e2e-smoke`. Any quick pointers?

alex: welcome! For branch names we prefer `feature/onb-312-short-desc` (lowercase, dashes). The smoke job runs in a separate workflow — if it fails paste the failing job logs here.

sam: thanks. The job shows 'no tests matched' in e2e-smoke — how do I run smoke locally?

kyle: run `./scripts/run_smoke.sh` or `make smoke-local` — you might need to set up the docker env. Example:

```
export LOCAL_DOCKER=1
make smoke-local
```

mira: devex note: for first PRs run `pre-commit run --all-files` and `npm run lint` to avoid formatting failures. We have a pre-commit hook that fixes many things automatically.

sam: ok running pre-commit fixed prettier issues, but GitHub shows 'needs review from CODEOWNERS' — who is CODEOWNERS for runtime?

alex: runtime `CODEOWNERS` lists @kyle and @infra-lead. If it's infra-level changes ping @kyle; if api/contract stuff ping @mira. For core runtime changes we prefer 2 approvals (one must be an owner).

kyle: I'll take a look in ~30m. If you're changing kernel selection code tag me directly. Also FYI we prefer small PRs (<300 LOC) and a short CHANGELOG entry in `changelogs/`.

sam: awesome, thanks all. One more: where's the style guide? I couldn't find one in the repo.

mira: style guide lives in `docs/dev/style-guide.md` but there's a condensed checklist in the PR template. Quick link: https://redwood.internal/docs/dev/style-guide (private). TL;DR: 2-space indent for JS, wrap at ~100 cols, prefer explicit types on public funcs.

devex-bot: Reminder: New contributors should add the `first-time-contributor` label to the PR if it's their first commit. See /labels for options.

sam: added the label, also renamed branch to `feature/onb-312-smoke-local`. pinging @kyle now. Thanks :pray:

kyle: saw it, leaving review comments. small nit: move that helper to `utils/kernel_utils.rs` and add a unit test so CI covers it.

sam: will do and push a follow-up. really appreciate the quick help! :smile:
